semanticRuntimeSelections.threadContract: The payload and explicit boundary token remain on their creating managed thread; no ambient termination handler, thread-local current payload or cross-thread transfer is supplied.
semanticRuntimeSelections.callbackContract: No native entry, observer or custom termination callback is supplied. Default FailFast occurs after the captured cleanup chain reaches the selected noexcept boundary.
